root.label: John Murdock resigns from Interior Department

events.label: John Murdock resigns from Interior Department

slots.name: years of service
slots.sentence: An 18-year veteran of the US Department of the Interior has resigned in protest from the sprawling federal agency, denouncing “a deeply troubling assault on the rule of the law” that took place at the department under Donald Trump.

slots.name: start date
slots.sentence: John Murdock, an attorney and self-described conservative Christian, began working for the agency’s legal office in 2002.

slots.name: resignation date
slots.sentence: “We are headed in the wrong direction,” wrote Murdock, who officially stepped down on 30 September.

slots.name: resignation status
slots.sentence: In resigning, Murdock, who now lives in Texas, acknowledged that he will probably pay a personal price.
